ai_exposure.reason: Underground work cannot be done remotely, and statutory safety duties sit with a named person. Planning software is exposed; being the accountable officer below ground is not.

nuances.statement: The degree gets you into the profession; the DGMS certificate gates the top of it. Under the Mines Act 1952 with the Coal Mines Regulations 2017 and the Metalliferous Mines Regulations 1961, the posts of Manager, Overman, Surveyor and Sirdar are STATUTORY - they can only be held by someone carrying a DGMS Certificate of Competency, and the holder carries personal legal liability for safety. First Class and Second Class Manager certificates require the degree or diploma PLUS documented underground or opencast experience, and are held for life subject to medical fitness. A mining engineer can work without one; they cannot run a mine.

professions.one_liner: Runs and maintains the engines and machinery of ships at sea.

deviating_roles.why: Shore roles are inspection, documentation and report-writing on a normal schedule. Sailing as an engine-room officer means months away, confined machinery spaces and emotional steadiness under isolation.

path_to_entry.requirement: Physics, Chemistry and Maths, usually with 60% and English at 50%
IMU CET or a DG Shipping approved institute entrance
B.Tech Marine Engineering at a DG Shipping approved institute (4 years)
Mandatory sea service on board ship
Certificate of Competency from the Directorate General of Shipping

entrance_exams.note: Only DG Shipping approved institutes count. Verify approval before joining any college.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership excluded — that is Sector 5 economics, not this profession's.

demand_signal.note: Employment is on internationally flagged ships regardless of where you train, so the career is global by nature even when the qualification is Indian.

ai_exposure.reason: Among the least exposed careers in the dataset. The work is physical, at sea, on machinery, and a licensed officer must hold the watch. Remote and autonomous shipping is decades from replacing this.

nuances.statement: Only DG Shipping approved institutes lead to a Certificate of Competency. A degree from a non-approved college does not qualify you to sail. College choice is itself a gate here, unlike most engineering.

The sea time is part of the qualification, not something that follows it. A B.Tech Marine Engineering degree from a DG Shipping approved institute leads to the MEO Class IV Certificate of Competency, which requires a minimum of 183 days at sea including six months of engine-room watchkeeping on a vessel of at least 750 kW propulsion power, under a qualified engineer officer. Only DG Shipping approved institutes count - a marine engineering degree from an unapproved college does not lead to a CoC, and that is the single most expensive mistake available in this profession.

The band looks high against shore engineering and the comparison is not like for like. Sea pay is earned in contract cycles rather than twelve months a year, is substantially tax-advantaged for Indian seafarers meeting the days-outside-India condition, and is paid against months away from home in confined machinery spaces. It is not a higher salary for the same life.

nuances.statement: CoA registration protects the TITLE 'Architect', NOT the activity. Per the Supreme Court no registration is required to do architectural work — only registered persons may call themselves an Architect. Municipal plan sanction generally still requires a registered architect's stamp, which is why legal_accountability is retained, but this moat is weaker than in medicine, law or aviation.

Settled in Engineering & Making rather than Design & Creative Arts. Architecture is more than design: it is licensed, load-bearing and legally accountable for whether a building stands. Interior Designer and Landscape Designer are routed to Sector 8, which keeps the boundary sharp - decoration and space planning are design; structure and statutory responsibility are engineering.

professions.one_liner: Flies passenger and cargo aircraft for a living.

deviating_roles.why: Instructing is a teaching job — patience and the ability to stay calm while someone else makes mistakes at the controls. Line flying is procedural and largely solitary.

path_to_entry.requirement: Physics and Maths. Both can be added later through NIOS if you took another stream.
DGCA Class 2 medical, then Class 1 medical before training
200 flying hours at a DGCA-approved Flying Training Organisation
DGCA ground exams and the RTR(A) radio telephony test
Commercial Pilot Licence issued by DGCA. Minimum age 18, no upper age limit. There is no upper age limit.

entrance_exams.note: No degree needed. Entry is by medical fitness, flying hours and DGCA exams.

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years, EMPLOYED only. Business ownership excluded — that is Sector 5 economics, not this profession's.

ai_exposure.reason: Among the least exposed careers in the dataset despite heavy cockpit automation, because regulation requires licensed humans on the flight deck and the physical, medical and legal requirements are immovable. Autopilot has existed for decades without reducing pilot headcount.

nuances.statement: The 57 lakh figure is SELF-FUNDED and is the real gate into this career — a larger barrier than any DGCA examination. It excludes type rating, which is an additional cost.

Physics and Maths can be added later through NIOS, so a commerce or arts student is NOT blocked from this career. DGCA has separately approved dropping the PCM requirement altogether, pending Ministry of Civil Aviation approval.

Cost is the real gate and it is almost entirely self-funded: roughly 40 to 60 lakh rupees for CPL training, carried by the family before any income exists. That is the single largest entry cost in the taxonomy and it decides who can pursue this far more than any aptitude or examination does.

Do not read the size of the industry as the size of the profession. There are about 50 B.Tech textile engineering programmes in India, 20 government and 29 private, concentrated in IIT Delhi, ICT Mumbai, VJTI, NIT Jalandhar and Anna University. professions.one_liner: Designs and looks after the machines that hospitals use to diagnose and treat.

deviating_roles.why: Hospital clinical engineering is done beside clinicians and patients, under their pressure and vocabulary. Device design in the same profession is a solitary, spatial engineering job.

The service and calibration roles are hands-on physical work on a machine that is down and must be fixed today - the reward is care and steadiness, not invention. Device design at the other end of the same profession is solitary, spatial and open-ended. This is the widest internal split in Sector 2 and it is also a split in ENTRY: the service roles are reachable on a diploma, the design roles are not.

demand_signal.note: One labour market, two ends. DESIGN work is thin because India imports most of its medical devices. INSTALLATION, calibration, service, regulatory and procurement work is large and durable precisely BECAUSE the design happens elsewhere - every imported machine needs someone here to commission and maintain it. Moderate is the honest average of a weak half and a strong half.

ai_exposure.reason: Devices are physical and safety-critical, and hospital clinical engineering means hands on equipment people's lives depend on. Design documentation is exposed; commissioning an MRI is not.

nuances.statement: Tagged undergrad because that is the DESTINATION for design, regulatory and clinical engineering work. It is not a door. The service and calibration half of this profession is genuinely reachable on a two-year diploma, and a diploma holder converges on the same mid-career band - which is why Biomedical Equipment Technician is a job role here rather than a profession of its own.

Biomedical Equipment Technician was a separate profession until it failed the merge test: same object of concern, same industry, and the two records had written the SAME demand sentence from opposite ends, with an identical mid-career midpoint of 7 lakh. It differed only in entry route, and entry route is not a skill set. Folded in as job roles, with the split recorded in role_spread.

The NCAHP Act's ninth category, Medical Technologists and Physician Associate, names Biomedical Engineer as a covered title. That Act regulates allied health PRACTICE inside Indian clinical care; it does not gate device design, manufacture or field service, so no licensing body is named here.

nuances.statement: Deliberately broader than 'Semiconductor Fab Technician'. A coverage probe found no existing profession covering cleanroom process work, but naming it after semiconductors alone would bet the record on one emerging industry. Pharma cleanroom operation is the same skill set and employs large numbers in India today.

The salary band is shipped at its current level and rests in part on the India Semiconductor Mission delivering operational fabs at scale. Pharmaceutical and medical-device cleanroom demand is established and carries the record on its own; the semiconductor half is the part that depends on a policy cycle landing.

professions.one_liner: Designs and runs nuclear reactors, and keeps the radiation safely contained.

path_to_entry.requirement: Physics and Maths compulsory
JEE Main, or a state or private engineering entrance
B.Tech in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Electronics, Metallurgy or Nuclear — or M.Sc Physics/Chemistry
Clear GATE — this is the real gate into the Department of Atomic Energy
One-year BARC Training School course via OCES or DGFS, then appointment as Scientific Officer

entrance_exams.note: GATE is the decisive exam. BARC screens on a GATE score from any of the last three years.

entry_window.constrained_route: JEE Main — admits only recent class 12 passouts
bypass: 3-year engineering diploma, then lateral entry into B.Tech year 2
B.Sc graduate lateral entry into B.Tech year 2
M.Sc Physics or Chemistry route into OCES, which bypasses B.Tech entirely

economics.basis: mid_career is 5-8 years, EMPLOYED only. Pay follows central government Group A scales.

demand_signal.note: India's nuclear capacity expansion and the opening of the sector to private participation are growing this, but absolute headcount stays small and concentrated in DAE units.

ai_exposure.reason: Among the most consequence-heavy engineering work there is — a licensed, accountable human is required at every safety decision. Simulation is exposed; deciding whether a reactor is safe to restart is not.

nuances.statement: You do NOT need a nuclear engineering degree. BARC recruits from Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Electronics, Metallurgy, Physics and Chemistry — GATE is the real gate, not the branch name. An M.Sc Physics graduate can enter OCES without any B.Tech at all.

The band is shipped as it stands and reflects central government Scientific Officer pay scales. Those carry allowances, subsidised housing and pension terms that do not appear in a CTC figure, so comparison with a private-sector offer of the same number understates the government package.

routed_elsewhere.why: Craft is aesthetic and spatial design, not structural making. Architect stays here because it is licensed and structural.
Designs how a product looks and feels; the engineer designs how it works.
Sector 2 is industrial and technical making. Sector 8 is craft and aesthetic making. Handloom weaving and pottery follow the same rule.
Kept with the agriculture value chain where students looking for farm careers will find it. Contestable — see boundary notes.
Writes code. Chip Design Engineer stays here because it designs hardware.
Purpose defines it — the goal is environmental outcomes, not the artefact.
Hosting people. Pilot stays here as licensed technical operation of complex machinery.
PROVISIONAL — navigation and cargo command rather than machinery. May belong here instead; flagged for review.
Craft and garment construction. Textile ENGINEERING — fibre, machinery, dyeing chemistry — stays here.
Uniformed public service under the cross-cutting rule, like Police Officer. The industrial fire prevention side stays here as Fire & Safety Engineer.

merged_into.why: Solar PV installation is electrician skill plus a specialisation, and the roles were already duplicated across three professions. Findable via the Solar job roles and the SCGJ green-jobs tag.
Passed the interest-alignment half of the profession test but failed the separate-skill-set half. Findable via the vehicle job roles and the ASDC automotive tag.

Not a separate profession - a job role. Same object of concern and the same labour market, described from the service end instead of the design end. Identical mid-career midpoint. The only real difference was entry route, diploma versus degree, and a route is not a skill set. Contrast Electrician vs Electrical Engineer, which DO both stand: wiring a building and designing a grid are different daily work, not two ends of one job.

boundary_decisions_needing_your_signoff: ARCHITECT sits here, not in Design & Creative Arts. Reasoning: statutory CoA licence, PCM prerequisite, structural responsibility, and the output is a physical building. Interior and landscape DESIGN are routed to Sector 8, so the boundary is craft-versus-licensed-construction. This is the single most contestable placement in the sector.

COMMERCIAL PILOT and AIRCRAFT MAINTENANCE ENGINEER sit here as licensed technical operation of machinery, while Cabin Crew goes to Hospitality. If you prefer an operations-versus-making split, both would move.

AGRICULTURAL ENGINEER routed to Sector 15 rather than kept here. The rule applied is that B.Tech branches normally live here, so this is a deliberate exception to keep Sector 15 substantive. Reverse it if you would rather all B.Tech branches sit together.

CHIP DESIGN ENGINEER is here rather than Sector 1 because it designs hardware; Embedded Software is in Sector 1 because it writes code. The two are adjacent and students may not see the difference from the names alone.

SKILLED TRADES are distributed inside this sector by degree_dependency = certificate, exactly as the brief specified, rather than being split into their own sector. Twelve of twenty-eight professions here are trades.

1.0: Initial build. 28 professions: 16 degree-tier, 12 certificate-tier trades.
AMIE / Institution of Engineers route excluded from all path_to_entry — post-2013 recognition unresolved in Delhi High Court.
Tier A verified: DGCA pilot licensing. Tier B verified: JEE subject gates, B.Arch eligibility, ITI/NCVT trade entry.
ITI age cap of 40 recorded as an entry_window on every trade.
2.0: Added cost_barrier — SPARSE and verified-only, null unless money is a primary gate. Commercial Pilot is the first populated case at 35-80 lakh self-funded, which is a bigger barrier than any exam in this dataset. This is the disciplined version of the cost_of_entry field withdrawn earlier: no universal estimates, only the handful of cases where cost decides.

Added earning_note — flags where entry_salary_band_inr systematically understates, chiefly trades and freelance-heavy professions where self-employment is common. Qualitative by design; no fabricated numbers.
3.0: Replaced entry_salary_band_inr and earning_note with a three-part economics block: cost_of_entry_lakh, early_earnings_lpa (years 1-3), mid_career_lpa (years 5-8, EMPLOYED only), and derived payback_years.

Entry pay alone was structurally biased toward long credentialed runways — it compared a 19-year-old welder with zero debt against a 22-year-old engineer with 6 lakh of fees and called the welder poorer.
mid_career explicitly EXCLUDES business ownership. If a plumber's income depends on running a contracting firm, the earning attribute is entrepreneurship (Sector 5), not plumbing.

cost_of_entry is now universal rather than sparse, because the payback ratio needs a denominator. Anchored on verified fee data: government ITI 0.05-0.4 L, government B.Tech ~6 L, private B.Tech ~13 L, CPL 35-80 L.
4.0: Added shipping block, DERIVED from data/filter_rules.json — never hand-set. Professions failing the compensation filter are flagged ship:false and RETAINED, not deleted.

Kept rather than deleted for three reasons: the 4.5 threshold is calibrated for urban India and a tier-3 threshold would differ; the threshold is a product decision that will be tuned; and a flag can be rendered as a delete while a delete cannot be rendered as a flag.
5.0: Removed the stored shipping block. ship/filtered is a DERIVED value — computable any time from economics.mid_career_midpoint + ai_exposure.band + data/filter_rules.json. Storing a derived value only creates drift risk. The rule lives in filter_rules.json; the application evaluates it at query time.
6.0: Re-scored clarity across the sector under the sharpened definition — clarity of OBJECTIVE and PROBLEM: what, how, FOR WHOM, and why. The 'for whom' dimension was previously underweighted.
Replaced the shipping block with a single derived boolean `filter`. True = passes the compensation rule in data/filter_rules.json. Validated on every export so it cannot drift.
7.0: tools/audit.py first run caught three tier errors: Marine Engineer, Architect and AME all named a licensing_body while sitting at tier B or C. Fixed by VERIFYING each against its statutory authority rather than by downgrading the tier.

CORRECTION on Architect: CoA registration is title protection, not activity licensing. Per the Supreme Court no registration is required to do architectural work — only to call yourself an Architect. Recorded in verified_facts and flagged for review.
Commercial Pilot entry_window set to null. DGCA imposes no age or recency limit, so an all-null window carried no information.
8.0: Added nuances — a list of {field, statement, source?} recording settled subtleties where a tag value alone would mislead.
RULE: nuances are SETTLED, admin_review is UNSETTLED. A nuance is something true we already know; an admin_review is a decision a human still owes. Without that line nuances becomes a dumping ground.
Every nuance must name a field that actually exists on the record — validator-enforced.
The Architect title-protection note moved out of admin_review.reason, where it did not belong.
9.0: Added three professions found by a coverage gap review: Textile Engineer, Biomedical Engineer, Fire & Safety Engineer. 28 -> 31.

Textile Engineer closes a real gap — India's textile industry is the second-largest employer after agriculture and TSC is a dedicated NSDC council. Earlier routing sent all textile work to Sector 8, which was only half right: apparel production is craft, textile engineering is industry.
Biomedical Engineer added with a HIGH admin_review: India's device design industry is small and graduate outcomes are known to be weak relative to the degree.

Fire & Safety Engineer added. Verified Section 40B of the Factories Act: the statutory Safety Officer post needs a degree PLUS five years, so it is recorded as a nuance rather than as the entry identity.
Firefighter routed to Sector 7 as uniformed public service, per the cross-cutting rule.
10.0: Added demand_signal { india_demand, pathway } — two ORTHOGONAL questions that were being conflated.

india_demand asks whether society needs this work. pathway asks where you can realistically train for it: 'india', 'any', or 'abroad'. A weak Indian pathway is NOT weak demand — India imports most medical devices, which is evidence of demand, not absence of it.
pathway deliberately does NOT rate Indian institutions as strong or weak. It states where the training exists, which is factual and actionable, rather than passing judgment on colleges.
11.0: Renewable Energy Engineer was PROPOSED and REJECTED. tools/probe.py found strong overlap with Solar Panel Technician (certificate tier) and Electrical Engineer (degree tier). Added Solar Plant Engineer, Wind Energy Engineer and Grid Integration Engineer as job roles on Electrical Engineer instead.
A new profession costs economics, verification, AI scoring and review. A job role costs one line. Probe first.
12.0: Added Drone Pilot & Operator (Tier A, DGCA Remote Pilot Certificate) and Precision Manufacturing Technician. 31 -> 33.

Both were probed against the existing taxonomy first. Drone work showed only partial overlap — Land Surveyor had one drone job role, but flying under DGCA rules is a different skill set from surveying. Cleanroom process work showed no overlap at all.
Semiconductor Fab Technician became a JOB ROLE under the broader Precision Manufacturing Technician rather than a profession of its own, so the record does not depend on one emerging industry.
Drone Pilot is reachable on a CLASS 10 PASS — the most accessible statutorily licensed profession in the taxonomy so far.
13.0: PART A of the demand-side cleanup. 33 -> 32 professions.

MERGED Solar Panel Technician into Electrician. Solar roles were duplicated across three professions — Electrician already listed 'Solar Installation Electrician' while Solar Panel Technician listed 'Solar Electrician'. Same person. Solar PV is electrician skill plus a specialisation, not a separate skill set.

MERGED Automobile Engineer into Mechanical Engineer. It passed the interest-alignment half of the profession test but failed the separate-skill-set half — same thermodynamics, mechanics, CAD and materials. Two professions with the same skill profile always surface together in a psychometric recommender.
ADDED Nuclear Engineer. Verified that BARC OCES/DGFS recruits from many engineering and science disciplines on a GATE score, so a dedicated nuclear degree is not required.
ADDED job roles found via EveryEng's domain list: Piping Design Engineer, Turbomachinery Engineer, Rolling Stock / Railway Engineer (all Mechanical).
FIXED exact duplicates: Petroleum's 'Production Engineer' renamed 'Oil & Gas Production Engineer'; 'Process Safety Engineer' removed from Chemical, where Fire & Safety Engineer is its home.
14.0: PART B. Added role_spread — records which job roles inside a profession deviate from its baseline, and on which of the 19 psychometric factors.

higher/lower are RELATIVE to the profession's own profile, never absolute scores. Actual scoring stays in the separate psychometric pipeline; this only flags internal variance so the pipeline and the UI know where one profession contains two different people.
Factor names are constrained by data/psychometric_factors.json and every named role must exist in that profession's job_roles — both validator-enforced.
12 of 32 professions in this sector are 'wide'.
15.0: Cross-file reconciliation caught a merge recorded as a routing — 'Solar Panel Technician' pointed at Sector 2 itself, which is meaningless. Added a separate merged_into block. A merge and a routing are different events and reconciliation only checks routings.

17.0: MERGED Biomedical Equipment Technician into Biomedical Engineer. It was a job role wearing a profession's clothes.

The evidence was already in the file and had not been read side by side: the two demand notes wrote the SAME sentence from opposite ends - one said design is thin because devices are imported, the other said service is strong because devices are imported - and both carried an identical mid_career_midpoint of 7.0 with the same AI band.

The only real difference was ENTRY ROUTE, diploma versus degree. Section 3 already says degree_dependency is the destination and not the door, so a route cannot by itself justify a separate profession. Recorded as a nuance on degree_dependency instead.

Not merged into Electrical Engineer, the other candidate: that profession is power systems - substations, transmission, grid integration. Servicing an MRI is electronics and instrumentation, not power.
The design-versus-service split is now the widest role_spread in Sector 2, and it is a split in entry as well as temperament.
demand_signal moves low -> moderate. The old 'low' described only the design half; the merged profession contains the strong service half too.
18.0: RESEARCH BATCH. Four admin_review items closed; Sector 2 review queue is now empty.

Mining Engineer moves Tier B -> TIER A. DGMS Certificates of Competency are statutory under the Mines Act 1952: Manager, Overman, Surveyor and Sirdar posts can only be held by certificate holders, who carry personal legal liability for safety. licensing_body set to DGMS and legal_accountability true.

Marine Engineer: MEO Class IV verified - 183 days at sea including six months engine-room watchkeeping on 750 kW or greater vessels, and only DG Shipping approved institutes count. The sea time is part of the qualification, not experience after it. Sea pay recorded as contract-cycle and tax-advantaged rather than simply higher.

Textile Engineer moves demand moderate -> LOW. About 50 B.Tech programmes nationally and few core openings, with most graduates going non-core. The INDUSTRY is India's second-largest employer; the PROFESSION is small. Do not read one as the other.
Welder: certification is what moves pay - coded, pressure-vessel and offshore work earn multiples of the shop-floor rate - and physical risk is recorded as part of the job description.
